name: ov-clip
description: Firefox extension that saves the page you are reading into OpenViking, using ovx's Vault login

scripts.clean: rm -rf build popup options background.js dist
scripts.lint: biome check . && npm run build && web-ext lint
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --overwrite-dest --artifacts-dir dist

//: readability and turndown are bundled into the shipped popup, so they are runtime dependencies even though nothing installs them at runtime. Listing them as dev would break any --omit=dev build and misstate what the artifact contains.
